subject: KestrelPay SOC 2 intake: onboarding, training & background evidence request
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@kestrelpay.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 intake — onboarding/training/background evidence request

Hi Priya,

We're kicking off the SOC 2 intake for KestrelPay and need to collect a compact evidence bundle covering recent hires and training controls for the Q3–Q4 period. Specifically we need: 
- Redacted background-check confirmation for hires between 2028-07-01 and 2028-10-31
- Training completion log for security awareness and phishing for the same cohort
- Onboarding/deprovisioning checklist and a summary of access-revocation timelines for leavers

Can Redwood provide a single package (PDF/CSV/DOCX) that we can upload into our evidence portal by 2028-11-10? If you can, please also include a short note describing how redactions were applied (PII removal).

Copying Marcus and Stephanie for alignment — they know where the source files live.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Park
Security Compliance Manager | KestrelPay
elena.park@kestrelpay.com

--
Attachments: none

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@kestrelpay.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Nov 2028 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 intake — onboarding/training/background evidence request

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble the bundle and aim to get it to you well before 11/10. Quick clarifications: 
1) For "redacted background-check confirmation" — do you want a single consolidated PDF with per-person entries redacted (we usually remove full DOBs and SSN fragments), or a CSV manifest plus per-person redacted PDF receipts?
2) For training logs — do you need proof-of-completion certificates or an exported roster showing completion timestamps?

Plan: I'll pull the artifacts and Marcus will prepare the redaction pass. Stephanie will include a short runbook describing our redaction rules and deprovisioning lead times.

I'll attach an onboarding checklist template so you can confirm the format.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Security & Compliance Analyst | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com
Attachment: onboarding_checklist_kestrel.docx (stub: checklist template)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Elena Park <elena.park@kestrelpay.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Nov 2028 14:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 intake — onboarding/training/background evidence request

Hi all — attaching the export we pulled: training_roster_nov2028.csv (columns: name, hire_date, training_completed, completion_ts, cert_id) and a consolidated PDF with redacted background-check confirmations for the requested window (redacted_bgchecks_kestrel_Q3_2028.pdf).

Redaction notes (short):
- Full names retained; DOBs replaced with year-only when allowed by contract (e.g., 1986 -> 1986), SSNs removed except last 4 when necessary and permitted by your intake rules.
- We removed scanned government IDs and replaced with confirmation lines ("ID verified") in the PDF.
- For contractor hires where we used an external vendor, the vendor receipt is included and vendor PII was left unredacted where the vendor provided consent — let me know if you need those removed as well.

Stephanie: can you add the deprovisioning timeline note (typical revocation within 24–48 hours of termination plus ticket evidence) and upload both to the shared Drive link for Elena?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Security Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
Attachments: training_roster_nov2028.csv (stub), redacted_bgchecks_kestrel_Q3_2028.pdf (stub)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@kestrelpay.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Nov 2028 16:43:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 intake — onboarding/training/background evidence request

Elena — uploaded both files to a shared folder and included a brief runbook (onboarding_checklist_kestrel.docx) that explains:
- Our onboarding steps and owner (HR -> IT -> Security checks)
- When accounts are created and standard access review cadence
- Deprovisioning SLA: 24–48 hours typical; emergency revocations handled within 2 hours with manager approval

Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cKestrel-Audit
DocuSign intake (signature for custodial transfer) is also awaiting your sign-off: https://app.docusign.com/MOCK/12345-Kestrel-Intake

Let us know if you want the vendor receipts fully redacted; otherwise this package should be upload-ready.

—Stephanie
